translation: Slightly warm, not poisonous. Its chief actions are to treat wind-pathogen of the intestines and stomach, cold-heat, swelling-masses, wind of the head and brain, wind qi coming and going, nasal stuffiness, yellow eyes, deafness, warm the center, down-drive qi, induce sweating, strengthen yin, boost essence, calm the five viscera, and free the nine orifices, ...
